v5_priv_regression_repair_2026_08_04.regression_found: Both declared MT-010 proofs FAILED with 403 Forbidden on every navigation route. Cause: the HBR-PRIV work in this same packet made api/model_lane_navigation.rs account-scoped (it now reads through ModelLaneStore::new_for_owner via RequestAccountScope), and MT-010's suite predates that seam - it sent no X-Handshake-Owner-Account header and seeded its rows through an UNSCOPED ModelLaneStore::new(pool), i.e. with a NULL owner.
v5_priv_regression_repair_2026_08_04.why_this_matters: The 403 was CORRECT behaviour, not a bug in the route. The defect was that a declared proof of this packet was left un-updated by a change made elsewhere in the same packet, so MT-010 would have failed validation for a reason that had nothing to do with navigation.
v5_priv_regression_repair_2026_08_04.repair: Two halves, because fixing only one produces a false pass. (1) The fixture now SEEDS under a real owning account via ModelLaneStore::new_scoped - without this the rows stay NULL-owner and every scoped probe returns 404, which would look like a navigation bug. (2) The fixture's reqwest client carries the owning account as a DEFAULT header, so the requirement lives in one place instead of being repeated at seven call sites.
v5_priv_regression_repair_2026_08_04.not_a_weakening: No assertion was relaxed and no test was deleted. The suite got STRICTER: it now proves the navigation projections resolve under a real account scope, which it never did before. A new negative control, navigation_rejects_a_caller_with_no_account_scope, proves the routes still refuse an unscoped caller with the stable RESOURCE_SCOPE_REQUIRED code and no resource identifiers in the body (HBR-PRIV-004) - so the fixture's default header cannot be masking a route that enforces nothing. Executed test count went UP, 3 -> 4.
v5_priv_regression_repair_2026_08_04.assertion_correction: The negative control initially asserted the reason code in `detail` and failed (left: the human sentence, right: RESOURCE_SCOPE_REQUIRED). AccountScopeRejectionBody puts the stable code in `error` and the human sentence in `detail`; the assertion was corrected to pin `error`, which is the field a caller should depend on.
